$description: Notice (platform/components/Notice): the tokens of the section message, its title, actions and dismiss button (library wave 4); its tone and box tokens are in components.tokens.json.

notice-body-row-gap.$description: Notice: the space between the title, the text and the actions of a section message.

notice-title-font-weight.$description: Notice: the weight of a section message’s title, at the notice’s size and in its tone’s content color.

notice-actions-gap.$description: Notice: the space between a section message’s action buttons.

notice-actions-margin-block-start.$description: Notice: the extra space above a section message’s actions, which sets them apart from the text.
